summary: The form 6-K filed by Smith & Nephew plc, a UK-based foreign private issuer, reports the results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 6, 2026, with all 27 ordinary and special resolutions passed, including director elections, remuneration approval, and share allotment authorizations. This is a routine reporting of proxy vote outcomes with no special situation event. The filing is equivalent to a US Form 8-K disclosure of meeting results. There are no deal terms, as it is not a transaction.
